name: Innovation Lightning Lab
description: Fast ideation workshop template for generating, stress-testing, and selecting unconventional ideas.

sections.title: Challenge Prompt
sections.instruction: State the problem, constraint, customer, or future scenario the group explored

sections.title: Wild Ideas
sections.instruction: List raw ideas, including impractical or provocative ones, without over-polishing

sections.title: Patterns & Themes
sections.instruction: Summarize clusters, repeated concepts, surprising connections, or emerging opportunity areas

sections.title: Assumption Breakers
sections.instruction: List assumptions the team challenged and what became possible when those assumptions were removed

sections.title: Shortlisted Concepts
sections.instruction: Capture ideas selected for further exploration, why they stood out, and expected value

sections.title: Experiment Cards
sections.instruction: Define lightweight experiments, success signals, owners, and time boxes

sections.title: Discarded But Interesting
sections.instruction: List ideas not selected now but worth saving for future sessions
